context.research_question: Do finite shaped RF and semisolid coherence memory preserve conditional CEST/Solomon-relay targets, including zero offset, under a verified full-history calculation?
context.target_rationale: Keep amide/relay differences >=0.005, full-trace normalized coarse/fine difference <=0.0002 and lag-cell kernel error <=1e-6. A contrast-passing but numerically unconverged waveform must not qualify. Select minimum per-train RF energy only among designs passing every gate.
context.assumptions: Authored homogeneous liquid/semisolid and dipolar-pair priors, no measured molecular calibration. Finite sampled-Hann pulses and continuous carrier phase; no history cutoff/reset, zero-offset absorption clamp, fitted image gain or full Redfield claim.
